Customer: how do i  edit my sender email alias
Support: To update your sender name, follow these steps.

1. In the left sidebar, click Marketing, then Cold Email Agent, and click Email Accounts at the top of the page.
2. Find the account in the table and click on its row to open the settings panel on the right.
3. Edit the First Name and Last Name fields in the settings panel to change your sender name.
4. Click Save.
